component.name: Moonlight Qt PyroWave
component.summary: Moonlight Qt game-streaming client with PyroWave support

description.p: Moonlight Qt PyroWave is an independent Moonlight Qt fork for streaming games and applications from a compatible Sunshine host.
In addition to Moonlight's H.264, HEVC, and AV1 paths, this build includes an explicitly selectable PyroWave Vulkan codec with SDR, HDR, YUV 4:2:0, and YUV 4:4:4 support.
PyroWave requires a compatible PyroWave-enabled Sunshine fork and a supported Vulkan GPU and driver.
